papers.title: Superlattice-Stabilized Fractional Chern Insulators in a "Berry Basin" Model
papers.abstract: The discovery of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene, following their discovery in the isolated topological flat band in twisted MoTe$_2$, motivates a search for the conditions under which an electronic band can host a topological correlated state. In this Letter we introduce a ``Berry basin" model which captures the essential features of rhombohedral graphene: a dispersive band with a flat bottom, momentum-space winding of a ``layer" degree of freedom, and Coulomb interactions, while also including periodic potentials, enabling controlled studies of the interplay of quantum geometry, superlattice modulation, and electron-electron interactions in producing correlated topological states beyond the isolated topological band paradigm. While integer Chern insulators emerge at strong coupling without a superlattice potential, stabilizing the fractional state requires nonzero potential for all interaction strengths we access. We provide insight into the greater robustness of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene when electrons are polarized away from the moiré interface. Our results establish a new class of systems that host robust fractional Chern insulators and provide a controlled numerical platform to test competing theories of interacting topological phases.

papers.title: Nucleation at the GST--oxide interface and beam-driven ordering in amorphous Ge--Sb--Te: HAADF, EDS and electron pair distribution functions across a 4D-STEM dose series
papers.abstract: Where crystal nuclei form in amorphous phase-change materials decides how they switch. We study six successive 4D-STEM scans, with simultaneous HAADF and EDS data, of a magnetron-sputtered Ge-Sb-Te (GST) film, restricted to the GST layer and its interface with the oxide beneath it. Nucleation sites do not differ in composition or number density: the nuclei lie on the same robust HAADF-EDS relation as the matrix, and at fixed HAADF the spread of the summed EDS signal equals its Poisson counting noise (ratio 1.03 +- 0.05). The nuclei are nevertheless crystalline and stand out in the 4D-STEM max-intensity virtual image (median z = 11.0) but not in HAADF (z = 1.3) or EDS (z = 0.3). We classify the film in four ways (HAADF intensity, I(q) phase mapping, PCA of the whole diffraction patterns and a self-supervised SimCLR encoder) and compare the electron pair distribution functions (PDFs) of all classes after calibrating reciprocal space on the Au cap. All bulk classes share one short-range structure (first shell 2.70-2.74 Å); towards the interface the first sharp diffraction peak (FSDP) moves to lower q, and every method isolates a thin interface-edge environment with a shorter or missing first shell. The I(q) classification isolates, in every scan, an interface environment that holds 62-100% of the nucleus pixels (1.2-2.5-fold above depth) and persists when the nucleus pixels are removed before classification. The interface, rather than a distinct composition or density of the nucleating volume, therefore marks where nuclei form. Over 4.7e3 e/Å^2 the HAADF signal falls by 17%, the first shell shortens by 0.03 Å and the FSDP narrows by 9%, apparently ordering the film as it damages it. All analyses used PySTEMLab, an interactive 4D-STEM analysis environment developed for this work.

papers.title: Reparameterizing GFN1-xTB for Ionic Liquids
papers.abstract: Ionic liquids are materials whose properties can be tailored for a wide range of applications, but their chemical diversity and complex electronic structure make systematic screening using quantum-mechanical methods computationally demanding. Semiempirical quantum methods offer an alternative, although their accuracy depends on their parameterization. We investigate the reparameterization of the DFTB method GFN1-xTB for predicting structural, energetic, and electronic properties of ionic liquids. For this purpose, we built a database containing over 14,000 conformations to construct training datasets and explored different parameterization strategies fitted to binding energies, forces, HOMO-LUMO gaps, and geometries. Analysis of the original GFN1-xTB model reveals systematic errors in these properties, with distinct behavior for saturated and aromatic cations. Thus, we investigate two models: CXMIM-xTB, a targeted model trained on imidazolium-based ionic liquids, and IL-xTB, a more general model designed to describe systems containing saturated and aromatic cations. CXMIM-xTB improves the description of binding energies, geometries, and frontier orbital energies while retaining computational efficiency. The model is subsequently applied to estimate electrochemical windows of ionic liquids, providing values consistent with DFT and experimental values. IL-xTB follows a hierarchical parameterization strategy including different cation and anion families and substantially reduces the systematic errors of GFN1-xTB across the chemical space considered, providing a route for developing xTB parameterizations with broader applicability to ionic liquids. Overall, both parameterization strategies outperform the original GFN1-xTB model, demonstrating that reparameterized methods provide an efficient approach for connecting configurational sampling with quantum-mechanical properties of ionic liquids.

papers.title: Interfacial Coupling Reshapes Nonlinear Polarization in a Spin-Defect van der Waals Heterostructure
papers.abstract: Van der Waals heterostructures offer a direct route to couple an optically active layer to a two-dimensional spin sensor, yet their coherent nonlinear response at interfaces remains poorly resolved. Here, we use polarization-resolved second harmonic-generation imaging to resolve four distinct regions of a hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) -based heterostructure, native hBN, neutron-irradiated hBN containing negatively charged boron vacancies (VB-), PbI2 and their complete overlap. The detected intensity scales quadratically with incident power, consistent with a dominant second-order optical process. Polarization scans show that adding PbI2 transforms the distorted VB- SHG anisotropy into a predominantly fourfold response with a sixfold stronger SHG than native hBN alone. This non-additive nonlinear response occurs in the same layer architecture also shown to enhance defect photoluminescence, linking spin-defect sensitization to an interface-modified effective second-order susceptibility.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；基于偏振分辨二次谐波成像与辐照缺陷样品；研究对象：hBN/PbI₂ 范德华异质结构，含中子辐照产生的带负电硼空位（VB⁻）

papers.title: Spectral Mapping Theorem between SU(N) and SU(Ns/N) Heisenberg Models and Exact Diagonalization of SU(4) and SU(7) Long-Range Ordered Phases on the Triangular Lattice
papers.abstract: We first show that, for the SU(N) Heisenberg model with isotropic two-site interactions on an arbitrary lattice of Ns sites, the full spectrum in its singlet sector (when N divides Ns) is the negative of the full spectrum in its singlet sector of the SU(Ns/N) Heisenberg model defined on the same lattice. This theorem, valid for models with the fundamental irreducible representation (irrep) at each lattice site, follows naturally from a transposition operation in the basis of Standard Young Tableaux (SYTs). Second, this basis -- previously recognized as particularly convenient for exact diagonalization (ED) of SU(N) Heisenberg models -- admits an efficient, memory-saving implementation, thereby enabling large-scale diagonalizations for unprecedented system sizes Ns and numbers of colors N>3. We apply these ideas to an ED study of the SU(4) and SU(7) Heisenberg models on the triangular lattice (TL), extending the calculations up to Ns=28 sites. In particular, starting from the SU(4) case, whose nearest-neighbor ground state remains debated, we confirm that next-nearest-neighbor couplings stabilize four-sublattice long-range order. We further find that increasing the number of colors from N=4 to N=7 provides another route toward a Néel-like ground state, even without such additional couplings. N = 4 to N = 7 provides another route toward a Néel-like ground state, even without such additional couplings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算为主，结合解析推导；依据为谱定理证明与精确对角化；研究对象：三角晶格上SU(N)海森堡模型，重点为SU(4)与SU(7)，格点数至Ns=28

研究问题：SU(N)与SU(Ns/N)海森堡模型单态谱之间是否存在普遍对应关系，以及能否借此扩展SU(4)、SU(7)三角晶格精确对角化的系统尺寸并澄清基态序。
证据与比较：摘要给出谱映射定理：当N整除Ns时，SU(N)模型单态扇区全谱等于同一晶格上SU(Ns/N)模型单态扇区全谱的负值；ED计算扩展至Ns=28，并比较SU(4)加次近邻耦合与SU(7)无次近邻耦合的情形。
papers.method_zh: 基于标准杨表（SYT）基的转置操作证明谱映射定理，并实现节省内存的SYT基精确对角化（ED），用于三角晶格SU(4)、SU(7)模型。

english_guide.question: Whether a general spectral correspondence exists between SU(N) and SU(Ns/N) Heisenberg models, and whether it enables larger exact diagonalization studies of SU(4) and SU(7) triangular-lattice phases.

english_guide.limitations: The theorem requires N dividing Ns and the fundamental irrep at each site; conclusions are limited to the models and sizes in the abstract, and finite-size effects are not specified.

papers.title: Contact-mediated asymmetric delay and rate memory in snapping beam pairs
papers.abstract: Slender structures in dense environments interact through contact, which alters how and when they become unstable. Here we show that contact makes snap-through history dependent, so that when and whether a beam pair snaps depends on how long the contact is loaded. Under cyclic compression, the pair snaps on loading, snaps on unloading, or stays packed, with the loading and unloading rates selecting among the three. Upon contact, one beam rolls along the other without slip, and faster driving lets it roll further before it slides and snaps: to larger compression on loading and to smaller compression on unloading. This delay is asymmetric between loading and unloading as the unloading branch carries a memory of the loading rate. Interestingly, above a threshold compression the pair snaps even when the compression is stopped, with the time to snap diverging at that threshold. By exploiting this asymmetric, rate-dependent delay, we program ordered sequences of snap events in arrays of pairs with tunable gaps, and demonstrate that the energy dissipated per cycle becomes a two-parameter function of the loading and unloading rates, increasing fourfold when, at the fastest loading, the return is slowed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论分析结合；依据为受控循环压缩实验及阈值、标度行为分析；研究对象：接触中的细长梁对（snapping beam pairs）及其阵列
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 接触使梁对的突跳（snap-through）具有历史依赖性：加载时长与速率决定其在加载、卸载时突跳或保持贴合，且卸载分支记忆加载速率。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：接触如何改变细长梁对失稳的时机与方式，加载和卸载速率如何选择突跳模式并影响能量耗散。
证据与比较：循环压缩下观察到加载突跳、卸载突跳、保持贴合三种结果；接触时一梁无滑滚动，驱动越快滚动越远；突跳延迟在加载与卸载间不对称；超过阈值压缩后停止加载仍突跳，突跳时间在阈值处发散；阵列中实现有序突跳序列；每周期耗散能随两速率变化，最快加载下减慢回程时增至四倍。
papers.method_zh: 对梁对施加循环压缩，改变加载与卸载速率及压缩量，观察突跳模式与滚动行为；在带可调间隙的梁对阵列中编程突跳序列并测量每周期能量耗散。

english_guide.finding: Contact makes snap-through history dependent: whether and when a beam pair snaps depends on how long the contact is loaded; under cyclic compression the pair snaps on loading, snaps on unloading, or stays packed, selected by loading and unloading rates.
english_guide.question: How contact alters when and how slender beam pairs become unstable, and how loading and unloading rates select snap mode and energy dissipation.
english_guide.evidence: Three outcomes under cyclic compression; no-slip rolling with faster driving rolling further before sliding and snapping; asymmetric delay; above a threshold compression the pair snaps after compression is stopped, with time to snap diverging at that threshold; ordered snap sequences in arrays; energy dissipated per cycle becomes a two-parameter function of rates, increasing fourfold when return is slowed at fastest loading.

english_guide.novelty: Authors state contact makes snap-through history dependent and reveal asymmetric rate-dependent delay with unloading branch carrying memory of loading rate.

papers.title: Role of defect trapping in the enhanced corrosion resistance of Ni-Mo alloys with yttrium and yttrium oxide additions
papers.abstract: Corrosion of structural alloys remains a critical challenge for advanced molten salt reactors, where aggressive fluoride salts promote continuous dissolution at the salt-metal interface. While most mitigation strategies emphasize thermodynamic stability, kinetic control of atomic transport has received comparatively less attention. Here, we propose a corrosion mitigation strategy based on diffusion control and vacancy trapping by dilute yttrium (Y) solutes and yttrium oxide (Y$_2$O$_3$) dispersions in Ni alloys. A combined computational and experimental approach integrates density functional theory (DFT), self-consistent mean-field (SCMF) diffusion modeling, and an impurity trapping model to quantify the impact of defect trapping on effective vacancy mobility. Strong first-nearest-neighbor vacancy-Y binding, off-lattice vacancy configurations, and elevated rotational and dissociation barriers result in pronounced suppression of vacancy diffusivity, while Y$_2$O$_3$-associated sites treated as fixed traps in the model further reduce the mobile vacancy population. Ni-Mo (NM), Y-modified (NMY), and Y$_2$O$_3$-containing (NMYO) alloys were tested in molten fluoride salt at 750°C. Corrosion penetration decreases systematically from NM to NMY to NMYO, consistent with the predicted reduction in vacancy-mediated transport. The same trend is observed in mass change, with net weight loss decreasing from 0.52% for NM to 0.23% for NMY and 0.09% for NMYO. These results are consistent with an alloy-side transport contribution from defect trapping and reduced atomic transport. This study therefore suggests point defect engineering as a promising alloy design strategy for extreme nuclear environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合；DFT、自洽平均场扩散建模与熔盐腐蚀实验结合；研究对象：Ni-Mo合金及添加Y或Y₂O₃的Ni-Mo合金，750°C熔融氟盐环境
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稀Y溶质与Y₂O₃弥散相通过空位捕获抑制空位扩散，使Ni-Mo合金腐蚀渗透与失重依次降低。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否通过缺陷捕获对原子输运的动力学控制，而非仅靠热力学稳定性，来提升结构合金抗氟盐腐蚀能力。
证据与比较：DFT显示强第一近邻空位-Y结合、离格点空位构型及较高旋转与解离势垒；SCMF与杂质捕获模型预测空位扩散率显著降低；750°C氟盐实验中腐蚀渗透由NM到NMY到NMYO依次下降，净失重由0.52%降至0.23%和0.09%。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论、自洽平均场扩散建模、杂质捕获模型，以及750°C熔融氟盐腐蚀实验与失重测量。

english_guide.finding: Dilute Y solutes and Y2O3 dispersions suppress vacancy diffusivity via vacancy trapping, systematically reducing corrosion penetration and net weight loss from NM to NMY to NMYO in molten fluoride salt at 750°C.
english_guide.question: Can kinetic control of atomic transport through defect trapping, rather than thermodynamic stability alone, mitigate fluoride-salt corrosion of structural alloys?
english_guide.evidence: DFT shows strong first-nearest-neighbor vacancy-Y binding, off-lattice vacancy configurations, and elevated rotational and dissociation barriers; SCMF diffusion modeling and an impurity trapping model predict reduced vacancy mobility. Corrosion penetration decreases from NM to NMY to NMYO, with net weight loss decreasing from 0.52% to 0.23% and 0.09%.

english_guide.novelty: The authors propose a corrosion mitigation strategy based on diffusion control and vacancy trapping by dilute Y solutes and Y2O3 dispersions, suggesting point defect engineering as a promising alloy design strategy.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract reports only 750°C molten fluoride salt conditions and three alloys; salt composition, exposure duration, characterization details, and mechanical or long-term service performance are not specified.

papers.title: Graphene-Confined Growth of Few-Layer PtSe2 via One-Step Selenization
papers.abstract: Platinum diselenide (PtSe$_2$), a member of the transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) family, is a promising material for next-generation electronic and optoelectronic applications due to its thickness-dependent properties, transitioning from semimetallic in bulk to semiconducting behavior at the few-layer limit. However, the scalable fabrication of large-area ultrathin PtSe$_2$ films remains challenging, as conventional selenization of pre-deposited Pt layers often leads to undesired three-dimensional clustered growth. This work explores a novel strategy for promoting two-dimensional growth of PtSe$_2$ by employing a graphene-mediated confinement approach. The method involves coating a Pt layer with graphene oxide (GO), followed by annealing in a selenium atmosphere, which results in the simultaneous formation of PtSe$_2$ and the reduction of GO to graphene. The graphene overlayer acts as a physical confinement layer, suppressing vertical growth and enabling the synthesis of graphene-confined PtSe$_2$ heterostructures on centimetre-scale substrates and promoting lateral connectivity of PtSe$_2$ regions observed by STEM. Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), including temperature-resolved in situ atomic-resolution measurements, was used to investigate the influence of selenization temperature on the growth mechanism and structural evolution of PtSe$_2$ films. The results show that graphene confinement stabilizes lateral growth and promotes the formation of few-layer films with improved structural ordering. Beyond PtSe$_2$, this graphene-assisted approach provides a general strategy for fabricating and stabilizing ultrathin TMD layers, including those prone to environmental degradation, providing a new outlook for enabling detailed studies of their intrinsic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验，依据为STEM表征与退火合成；研究对象：石墨烯限域少层PtSe₂薄膜及PtSe₂/石墨烯异质结构
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 石墨烯覆盖层作为物理限域层抑制PtSe₂垂直生长，促进横向连通与少层有序成膜。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何抑制预沉积Pt层硒化时的三维团簇生长，实现大面积超薄PtSe₂的二维可扩展制备？
证据与比较：在厘米级衬底上获得石墨烯限域PtSe₂异质结构；STEM观察到PtSe₂区域横向连通；温度分辨原位原子分辨STEM考察硒化温度对生长机制与结构演化的影响，结果显示限域稳定横向生长并改善结构有序度。
papers.method_zh: Pt层上涂覆氧化石墨烯（GO），在硒气氛中退火，同步形成PtSe₂并将GO还原为石墨烯；用STEM及温度分辨原位原子分辨STEM表征。

english_guide.finding: Graphene confinement suppresses vertical growth of PtSe2, promoting laterally connected few-layer films with improved structural ordering on centimetre-scale substrates.
english_guide.question: How to suppress three-dimensional clustered growth during selenization of pre-deposited Pt layers and enable scalable two-dimensional growth of ultrathin PtSe2 films?
english_guide.evidence: Graphene-confined PtSe2 heterostructures formed on centimetre-scale substrates; STEM showed lateral connectivity of PtSe2 regions; temperature-resolved in situ atomic-resolution STEM examined selenization temperature effects on growth mechanism and structural evolution.
english_guide.method: A Pt layer was coated with graphene oxide (GO) and annealed in selenium atmosphere, simultaneously forming PtSe2 and reducing GO to graphene; STEM including temperature-resolved in situ atomic-resolution measurements was used.
english_guide.novelty: The authors propose a graphene-mediated confinement strategy for one-step selenization promoting two-dimensional PtSe2 growth, suggested as general for ultrathin TMD layers including those prone to environmental degradation.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify selenization temperatures, layer-number statistics, defect densities, or device performance; generality to other TMDs is only an outlook without experimental verification.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称提出石墨烯介导限域的新策略，一步硒化促进PtSe₂二维生长，并可推广至其他易环境降解的超薄TMD层。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未给出具体硒化温度、层数统计、缺陷密度或器件性能数据；通用性仅为作者展望，未提供其他TMD的实验验证。

papers.title: DiffGA: Steering Frozen Diffusion Models for Materials Design via Evolutionary Search
papers.abstract: Steering candidate generation toward user-defined objectives is central to inverse materials design, yet remains difficult when objectives are black-box, changing, or non-differentiable, as in many simulation- and experiment-derived properties. Generative models offer a solution but typically require retraining or fine-tuning for each new objective, demanding labeled data and substantial compute, or rely on differentiable guidance that is brittle to gradient noise and undefined for many practical targets. We present DiffGA, a retraining-free framework that injects evolutionary search into the sampling trajectory of a retrained diffusion model, evolving partially denoised states under an arbitrary black-box oracle. Because oracle evaluation often dominates campaign cost, we couple DiffGA with an on-the-fly Bayesian surrogate that reuses representations from state-of-the-art machine-learned force fields (MLFFs). A Gaussian process is fit during the campaign on the force fields's graph embeddings and, once it demonstrably ranks an unseen generation, replaces expensive property evaluations under an uncertainty-aware acquisition rule, reducing oracle cost with negligible loss of accuracy. Across three crystal-design tasks using a frozen MatterGen backbone, DiffGA outperforms diffusion-only, compute-matched, purely evolutionary, and fine-tuned baselines in oracle-assessed rates of stable, unique, and novel hits. Rather than proposing scientific compounds, we use density functional theory to quantify MLFF oracle fidelity, showing that it is a faithful proxy in key regimes but systematically biased in others, delineating when proxy-driven generative discovery can be trusted. On a representative sample, DiffGA's top hits survive first principles re-evaluation as physically realistic hits, while the surrogate-accelerated pipeline preserves this fidelity at a fraction of the cost.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；基于扩散模型与进化搜索的生成式材料设计；研究对象：晶体材料设计；以冻结的 MatterGen 扩散模型为骨干，MLFF 代理与 DFT 评估
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DiffGA 在冻结扩散模型采样轨迹中注入进化搜索，配合 MLFF 表征的贝叶斯代理，在三个晶体设计任务中优于扩散、算力匹配、纯进化和微调基线。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何在目标为黑箱、可变或不可微时，无需重训练或微调即可将候选生成导向用户目标，并降低 oracle 评估成本？
证据与比较：三个晶体设计任务中，以 oracle 评估的稳定、唯一、新颖命中率比较 DiffGA 与扩散、算力匹配、纯进化、微调基线；用 DFT 量化 MLFF oracle 保真度，显示关键区间可信、其他区间存在系统偏差；代表性样本中顶级命中通过第一性原理复评。
papers.method_zh: 在冻结 MatterGen 扩散模型采样轨迹中对部分去噪状态做进化搜索；用 MLFF 图嵌入拟合高斯过程代理，按不确定性感知采集规则替代昂贵性质评估。

english_guide.finding: DiffGA injects evolutionary search into the sampling trajectory of a frozen diffusion model and, coupled with an MLFF-based Bayesian surrogate, outperforms diffusion-only, compute-matched, purely evolutionary, and fine-tuned baselines in oracle-assessed rates of stable, unique, and novel hits across three crystal-design tasks.
english_guide.question: How can candidate generation be steered toward user-defined objectives when objectives are black-box, changing, or non-differentiable, without retraining or fine-tuning and while reducing oracle cost?
english_guide.evidence: Oracle-assessed rates of stable, unique, and novel hits across three crystal-design tasks; DFT quantification of MLFF oracle fidelity showing faithful proxy behavior in key regimes but systematic bias in others; top hits surviving first-principles re-evaluation on a representative sample.
english_guide.method: Evolutionary search over partially denoised states in the sampling trajectory of a frozen MatterGen diffusion model under an arbitrary black-box oracle; Gaussian process surrogate fit on MLFF graph embeddings with an uncertainty-aware acquisition rule.
english_guide.novelty: Authors describe DiffGA as a retraining-free framework that injects evolutionary search into the sampling trajectory for arbitrary black-box oracles and uses an on-the-fly MLFF-representation Bayesian surrogate to reduce oracle cost.
english_guide.limitations: Abstract does not specify applicability conditions; MLFF oracle is systematically biased in some regimes; no scientific compounds are proposed; generality of the surrogate-accelerated pipeline is not stated.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称 DiffGA 为免重训练框架，可将进化搜索注入采样轨迹以适配任意黑箱 oracle，并用 MLFF 表征的在线贝叶斯代理降低 oracle 成本。

papers.title: EpNet-Si: Atomic Form Factors Learned from Band Structures
papers.abstract: The empirical pseudopotential method (EPM) computes band structures with one diagonalization per $k$ point and no self-consistency, but its fixed atomic form factors do not transfer between crystal structures. To address this limitation, we introduce EpNet-Si, an EPM for silicon in which an equivariant network predicts each atom's plane-wave form factor from its local environment: a species potential plus monopole, dipole and quadrupole corrections, mixed by a learned router over atomic densities, together with an $s/p$ nonlocal projector. With 6{,}195 parameters, the model is trained through the eigensolver on reference density functional theory (DFT) band energies of only 77 cells. Among 231 distortions of the trained structure types, the 142 gapped cells have mean band and gap errors of 15 and 8\,meV; among 192 unseen structures, the 165 gapped cells have mean errors of 38 and 49\,meV. Physical properties derived from EpNet-Si, including effective masses, gap pressure coefficients, deformation potentials and the density of states at the Fermi level, agree with those obtained from the reference DFT calculations. These results suggest that the classical EPM, fitted to a small set of reference data, can be extended into a fast alternative for modern electronic band-structure calculations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；基于DFT参考数据训练等变网络模型；研究对象：硅（Si）的能带结构，涵盖训练结构类型的231种畸变与192种未见结构
papers.abstract_summary_zh: EpNet-Si以仅77个参考晶胞训练，即可在畸变与未见结构中给出与参考DFT接近的能带和带隙，并复现有效质量等派生性质。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何克服经验赝势法（EPM）固定原子形状因子无法在晶体结构间迁移的局限，使其成为快速能带计算替代方案。
证据与比较：在训练结构类型的231种畸变中，142个有隙晶胞的平均能带与带隙误差为15和8 meV；在192种未见结构中，165个有隙晶胞的平均误差为38和49 meV；有效质量、带隙压力系数、形变势和费米能级态密度与参考DFT一致。
papers.method_zh: 构建含6,195个参数的等变网络，从局域环境预测每个原子的平面波形状因子，经本征值求解器端到端训练于77个晶胞的DFT能带能量。

english_guide.finding: EpNet-Si, trained on only 77 reference cells, reproduces DFT band energies and gaps with mean errors of 15 and 8 meV for 142 gapped distorted cells and 38 and 49 meV for 165 gapped unseen structures, and yields consistent effective masses, gap pressure coefficients, deformation potentials and density of states at the Fermi level.
english_guide.question: How can the empirical pseudopotential method (EPM), whose fixed atomic form factors do not transfer between crystal structures, be extended into a fast alternative for band-structure calculations?
english_guide.evidence: Among 231 distortions of the trained structure types, the 142 gapped cells show mean band and gap errors of 15 and 8 meV; among 192 unseen structures, the 165 gapped cells show mean errors of 38 and 49 meV; derived properties agree with reference DFT.
english_guide.method: An equivariant network with 6,195 parameters predicts each atom's plane-wave form factor from its local environment via a species potential plus monopole, dipole and quadrupole corrections, mixed by a learned router over atomic densities, with an s/p nonlocal projector, trained through the eigensolver on DFT band energies of 77 cells.

english_guide.limitations: The abstract covers only silicon; training uses 77 cells; errors are larger for unseen structures; temperature, strain range and computational cost details are not specified.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称将经典EPM经少量参考数据拟合后扩展为现代电子能带结构计算的快速替代方案。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要仅涉及硅；训练数据为77个晶胞，未见结构误差高于畸变结构；摘要未明确说明适用温度、应变范围及计算成本细节。

papers.title: Time-temperature-composition equivalence of the viscoelastic behavior through the glass transition of digitally mixed 3D-printed polymers
papers.abstract: The linear viscoelastic behavior of a polymer shows an equivalence of loading frequency and temperature, the time-temperature equivalence (TTE). Horizontal shifting extends moduli measured over limited ranges to much wider ranges, through the glass transition. Multimaterial 3D printing has created digitally mixed polymers, a new class in which elastomeric and glassy resins are mixed voxel by voxel in prescribed ratios. Composition shifts the location and breadth of the glass transition and increases the rubbery modulus. Here we extend TTE to a time-temperature-composition equivalence (TTCE). Across all measured temperatures, frequencies, and compositions, the storage modulus collapses onto one master curve. Composition translates the transition and stretches its breadth, both linearly. The phase angle and relaxation spectrum superpose under the same operations, so the family shares one distribution of relaxation times. A single closed-form TTCE gives the storage and loss moduli of the family, guiding graded and architected designs for elasticity and dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；基于3D打印样品的流变测量与主曲线分析；研究对象：多材料3D打印数字混合聚合物（弹性体与玻璃态树脂按体素比例混合）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将时间-温度等效推广为时间-温度-组分等效，使不同温度、频率和组分下的储能模量坍缩到一条主曲线。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：数字混合聚合物的线性黏弹行为能否用组分作为额外变量与频率、温度统一等效描述，并跨越玻璃化转变。
证据与比较：摘要称在所有测量的温度、频率和组分下储能模量坍缩为单一主曲线；组分线性平移转变并线性展宽其宽度；相角与松弛谱在同一操作下叠加，表明共享同一松弛时间分布。
papers.method_zh: 线性黏弹测量结合水平平移构建主曲线，并拟合闭式时间-温度-组分等效表达式。

english_guide.finding: Extending time-temperature equivalence to time-temperature-composition equivalence (TTCE), storage modulus collapses onto one master curve across all measured temperatures, frequencies, and compositions.
english_guide.question: Whether composition can serve as an additional variable unifying the linear viscoelasticity of digitally mixed polymers across the glass transition.
english_guide.evidence: Storage modulus collapses onto a single master curve; composition linearly translates and stretches the transition; phase angle and relaxation spectrum superpose, indicating one relaxation-time distribution.
english_guide.method: Linear viscoelastic measurements with horizontal shifting to construct master curves, fitted by a closed-form TTCE expression.
english_guide.novelty: Authors explicitly extend TTE to TTCE and provide a single closed-form expression giving storage and loss moduli of the family.
english_guide.limitations: Abstract does not specify measured ranges, sample details, or quantitative collapse error; scope limited to the measured digitally mixed polymer family.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者明确将时间-温度等效扩展为时间-温度-组分等效（TTCE），并给出描述该材料族储能与损耗模量的单一闭式表达式。

papers.title: A Minimal Theoretical Model for Morphodynamic Selection in Soft Matter Systems
papers.abstract: Soft matter systems often display shape transitions, mode competition, and threshold-like dynamical responses driven by the coupling between mechanics, geometry, and biochemical or active fields. Here we present a minimal theoretical framework for describing such morphodynamic selection using a small number of physically interpretable order parameters. The model combines elastic relaxation, active driving, and nonlinear feedback, yielding distinct regimes corresponding to weak deformation, single-mode selection, and coupled shape transformation. We derive the governing equations, identify the relevant dimensionless control parameters, and show how the phase behavior can be organized in terms of threshold competition and effective coupling strengths. The framework provides a compact route for connecting analytical theory, numerical simulations, and experimentally observable shape dynamics in soft and biological matter.

papers.title: Investigation on Thermal Stability of Epi-GeSn Directly on Si (001)
papers.abstract: In this paper we investigate the structural properties and thermal stability of metastable Ge1-xSnx epilayers (~4.5 at.% Sn) grown directly on Si(001) substrates by high-resolution X-ray diffraction (HRXRD) and Raman spectroscopy. Our results demonstrate that both 70 and 140 nm films are fully relaxed, with the thicker film exhibiting a small tensile strain (+0.09%). The thermal stability of the heterostructures was evaluated up to 813 K using temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and scanning electron microscopy. The surface-weighted Raman response (532 nm excitation) and surface morphology of the 70 nm film remain highly stable. In contrast, the 140 nm film undergoes severe degradation, characterized by significant attenuation and broadening of the Ge-Ge longitudinal optical phonon mode, alongside enhanced surface Sn segregation. These findings demonstrate that the thermal stability of direct GeSn/Si heterostructures is governed by the initial defect structure established during epitaxial growth, providing key design rules for understanding the fabrication of GeSn-based optoelectronic devices.

papers.title: Pressure-Driven Evolution of the Physical Properties of Layered Y2GaB and Y2InB MAB Phases: A Comparative First-Principles Study
papers.abstract: MAB phases are nanolaminated ternary borides in which strong in-plane M-B bonds and weaker interlayer interactions drive their distinctive stability and functionality. Hydrostatic pressure offers a direct route to tune the in-plane and interlayer interactions that govern the stability and functionality of layered Y2GaB and Y2InB borides. Here, first-principles calculations are used to compare their structural, elastic, thermophysical, electronic, bonding, optical, and vibrational responses from 0 to 20 GPa. Elastic criteria show that Y2GaB is stable at 0, 5, and 10 GPa, whereas Y2InB is stable only at ambient pressure. Within the stable Y2GaB range, compression increases the elastic moduli, acoustic velocities, Debye temperature, and lattice thermal conductivity while reducing the elastic anisotropy. Both compounds are multiband metals and spin-orbit coupling modifies local dispersions without opening a gap. Y2GaB retains nine Fermi-surface sheets from 0 to 10 GPa, whereas Y2InB has eight at ambient pressure, with no pressure-induced topological reconstruction. Charge-density and overlap analyses indicate mixed ionic-covalent Y-B bonding within a delocalized metallic background. Optical parameters are anisotropic. Unit-cell phonon spectra contain positive frequencies at 0 and 10 GPa, although expanded-supercell calculations reveal low-frequency sensitivity. These results establish mechanically viable pressure windows and clarify substitution-driven structure-property relationships for these borides.

papers.title: Spiral Edge States in Topological 2D Sb2Te3 Crystals
papers.abstract: This work explores the edge state conduction properties of twinned and spiraled, 2D Sb2Te3 topological insulator crystals. We show the structure supports spatially continuous edge states within two spiral and knotted edge conduction channels. The channels are connected through a topological defect. This geometry introduces boundary conditions into the 2D crystal that modifies the edge state dispersion. Using a combination of low loss Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy, Magnetic Force Microscopy and traditional carrier transport measurements we identify a distinct excitation at 0.155 eV in the spiral that seems to be related to two isolated states within the gap. This state is localized to the crystal edges. The modification of edge state bands using manipulation of a systems quantum geometry may open new avenues for the use of 2D topological systems.

papers.title: Pressure-transferable universal machine-learning potentials: the WBM-MatPES benchmark and Tuga-FF
papers.abstract: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials hold the promise to replace costly ab initio calculations in materials science workflows. However, the accuracy and transferability of current models are limited by the availability of training data. We release WBM-MatPES, a dataset of 182 thousand structures recomputed with consistent MatPES settings, together with two reference convex hulls of different depths and test sets at six pressures up to 150 GPa. These datasets reproduce a realistic discovery workflow and allow potentials to be ranked systematically at this level of theory, similar to the Matbench Discovery leaderboard at the Materials Project settings. In this benchmark, five published MatPES potentials agree within 12 meV/atom at 25 GPa, yet their errors increase dramatically to 0.4-5 eV/atom at 150 GPa. To address this limitation, we develop Tuga-FF, a graph transformer trained on datasets spanning ambient and high-pressure configurations alike. Tuga-FF is the most accurate model in the benchmark at ambient pressure, with an energy error of 13.6 meV/atom, and maintains an error of just 21 meV/atom at 150 GPa. We believe this benchmark will encourage the community to train higher-accuracy models and generate richer datasets, advancing machine-learned interatomic potentials as a whole.

papers.title: A Higher-Order Stroh Framework for Weakly Nonlinear Post-Bifurcation Analysis
papers.abstract: Linear stability analysis predicts the onset of wrinkling, while weakly nonlinear analysis determines whether the bifurcation is supercritical or subcritical through the sign of the cubic amplitude coefficient. When this coefficient vanishes, higher-order terms are needed. In this paper, we develop a higher-order Stroh framework for weakly nonlinear post-bifurcation analysis of finitely deformed elastic solids. For each nonzero harmonic, the same base-state Stroh operator is retained at every order, with nonlinear source terms assembled from lower-order fields to account for geometry, constitutive laws and constraints. This recursive structure, together with Fredholm solvability conditions, enables us to derive cubic, quintic and higher-order amplitude equations. Here, we demonstrate the power of this framework by analysing wrinkling in an incompressible neo-Hookean film bonded to an exponentially graded substrate. The results recover established linear instability benchmarks and the supercritical-subcritical transition in the homogeneous-substrate limit. For graded substrates, the cubic coefficient vanishes on a surface in the parameter space of modulus ratio and substrate gradation. On this surface, the quintic coefficient takes both signs, corresponding to supercritical and subcritical bifurcations. These regions are separated by a curve along which the quintic coefficient also vanishes. Determining the branch direction along this curve requires higher-order terms, which can be calculated within the same framework.

papers.title: Emergent one-dimensional Bloch oscillations in coupled Ising layers
papers.abstract: Bloch oscillations typically arise in periodic systems subjected to a constant force generated by a potential gradient. Here, we study domain-wall dynamics in coupled Ising layers under asymmetric longitudinal fields. The interlayer coupling is of Heisenberg type and acts as an effective transverse coupling in the emergent pseudospin representation. We show that the rung pseudospin structure gives rise to kinetic constraints, restricting the many-body dynamics to an emergent one-dimensional quasiparticle subspace within the original two-dimensional system. Furthermore, the imbalance between the longitudinal fields of the two layers induces an effective linear potential for the emergent domain-wall excitations, leading to their confinement between two oppositely polarized ferromagnetic domains. Remarkably, the resulting Wannier--Stark ladder of domain-wall excitations gives rise to Bloch oscillations in the absence of a conventional tilted potential, revealing a distinct mechanism for coherent quantum dynamics. Numerical simulations of time-dependent observables confirm the analytical predictions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论为主，数值模拟验证；摘要含解析预测与时变数值模拟；研究对象：耦合Ising层中的畴壁动力学，层间为Heisenberg型耦合，并施加不对称纵向场

证据与比较：解析表明梯级赝自旋结构产生动力学约束，将多体动力学限制在涌现一维准粒子子空间；两层层间纵向场不平衡给出有效线性势，使畴壁激发局域于两个反极化铁磁畴之间；时变可观测量的数值模拟与解析预测一致。

papers.title: Selective faceting induced by Hexagonal Boron Nitride on curved Platinum substrate
papers.abstract: This work combines experimental investigations and first-principles calculations to study hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) growth on a curved Pt(331) substrate. Low-energy electron diffraction (LEED) and scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM) were employed to investigate the structural properties, observing that hBN growth led to faceting with several stable facets: Pt(111), Pt(221), Pt(441), Pt(881), and Pt(110). Additionally, the electronic properties were examined by X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS) and near-edge X-ray absorption fine structure (NEXAFS), revealing an increase in the hBN-substrate interaction strength, from the weakest at the Pt(111) to the strongest at the Pt(110). Density functional theory (DFT) calculations confirm that the selective faceting mechanism is induced by hBN, which changes the order of relative stability of the uncovered facets. Although a complete understanding of the process is not achievable using only thermodynamical arguments, the comparison between hBN adhesion energies and clean surface free energies clearly indicates that some facets are stabilized with respect to others by stronger overlayer-substrate interaction, whereas for others the clean surface energetics plays the dominant role.

papers.title: Active remodeling rescues a microswimmer from geometric trapping
papers.abstract: Natural habitats confront microorganisms with heterogeneous, mechanically complex surroundings that shape how they move and explore. Most studies of motility in complex media treat the environment as either a homogeneous fluid or a rigid obstacle field. Here we instead study a medium that is simultaneously soft and reconfigurable --- deformable by the organism moving through it. We track the unicellular biflagellate microalga \emph{Chlamydomonas reinhardtii} swimming in a soft, disordered suspension of microgel particles comparable in size to the cell itself, across a range of gel packing fractions. With increasing packing fraction, trajectories change from long straight runs to short, frequently reorienting ones, and the effective translational diffusivity decreases monotonically. The bimodal run/tumble speed distribution, characteristic of the free-swimming gait, collapses toward a single mode as the packing fraction increases, by near-proportional slowing of both gait states rather than a redistribution of cells between them. Recasting trajectories as alternating hops and traps reveals the signature of a deformable medium: hop lengths halve as the gel densifies, approaching the microgel aggregate scale, while trapping times do not increase with increasing packing fraction. Independent force estimates place the cell's propulsive force close to an order of magnitude above that needed to deform a single grain, so remodeling is expected rather than merely observed. A minimal \emph{active remodeler} model --- an active Brownian particle among mobile, rigid obstacles --- shows that obstacle mobility alone is sufficient to relocate the onset of permanent trapping. Thus, our results establish obstacle mobility as a control parameter for motility in soft, disordered matter.

papers.title: Driven Vortex Motion in Periodic Channel Potential Embedded in Superconducting Films
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate vortex dynamics in periodically width-modulated superconducting channels by numerically solving the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau (TDGL) equations. The channels are designed with sinusoidally varying widths characterized by their average width and modulation amplitude. The motion of driven vortices generates an oscillatory electric field with a fundamental frequency, $f_0$, set by the channel periodicity, together with higher-order harmonics. In contrast to the situation of vortex lattice dynamics in a periodic pinning landscape of circular holes considered by Al Luhaibi et al. [1], we show that the harmonic content of the generated electric field can be effectively controlled through the channel geometry. In particular, appropriately engineered channel profiles strongly suppress higher-order harmonics, yielding an electric-field response that closely approaches a pure sinusoidal waveform. These results demonstrate that geometric modulation offers a viable route to engineering low-harmonicity microwave signals in superconducting devices and may enable cryogenic on-chip waveform generators for controlling superconducting qubits. Such devices could provide a useful building block for scalable transmon-based quantum computing architectures.

papers.title: Inverse Designing Reconfigurable Piezoelectric Tensors via Architectural and Modal Programming
papers.abstract: Piezoelectricity arises from the coupling between electric polarization and mechanical deformation, described by a third-rank tensor whose coefficients are constrained by crystal symmetry. In natural crystals, atomic periodicity and energetic stability restrict accessible symmetries, limited to 20 distinct anisotropies that can exist. Here we establish a general framework, based on graph representation, for controlling the full effective piezoelectric tensor through architecture by resolving how macroscopic symmetry, local polarization and deformation of structural elements act together. This enables each coefficient to be traced to the members that reinforce or cancel it and be controlled through targeted geometric changes. We further uncover frequency-selective tensor reconfiguration, in which excitation frequency switches the dominant piezoelectric coefficients of a single architecture. These principles open a broader class of applications in which a single piezoelectric architecture can deliver programmable sensing, actuation and mode conversion across multiple directions and deformation states. We realize a multi-degree-of-freedom actuator that integrates distinct actuation modes in one block and reduces volume by 90% relative to conventional multi-stack assemblies.

papers.title: Kink boundary-induced polarity revealed by nonreciprocal charge transport in FeTe0.7Se0.3 superconductor
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport, characterized by direction-dependent electrical response, provides a powerful probe of electronic structure and a platform for rectification. However, its realization is typically governed by intrinsic crystal symmetry, restricting the range of suitable materials. Here, we demonstrate nonreciprocal charge transport in an otherwise centrosymmetric superconductor, FeTe0.7Se0.3 (FTS), through kink boundary-induced strain engineering. The stress relaxation during growth generates a cusp-like kink-band boundary with asymmetric curvature, producing a spatially nonuniform strain field and an effective in-plane polarity that breaks inversion symmetry. Pronounced nonreciprocal transport is observed under out-of-plane magnetic fields, with strong dependence on current and temperature across the superconducting transition, in contrast to the negligible response in flat nanosheets. Our results identify kink boundary-induced symmetry breaking as a general route to engineer nonreciprocal charge transport in centrosymmetric systems.

papers.title: Finite-temperature adiabatic-connection reduced density-matrix functional theory: a unified framework for i-DMFT and TAO-DFT
papers.abstract: Accurately describing chemical bond breaking requires capturing strong/static electron correlation, a major challenge for single-reference self-consistent-field methods such as Hartree--Fock and Kohn--Sham density-functional theory (DFT). Fractional occupations substantially improve this situation, as demonstrated by information-density-matrix-functional theory (i-DMFT) and thermally-assisted-occupation DFT (TAO-DFT). Although useful, they are formulated within rather different theoretical frameworks, are somewhat semi-empirical, and their relationship remains unclear. Here we introduce finite-temperature adiabatic-connection reduced density-matrix functional theory (FT-AC-RDMFT), in which i-DMFT and TAO-DFT emerge as different reductions of a unified framework. The effective eigenvalue equation for natural orbitals and the Fermi--Dirac occupation numbers follow directly from the variational principle, while a thermal adiabatic connection relates the empirical entropy coefficient of i-DMFT to a characteristic temperature of the auxiliary non-interacting system. Within this framework, i-DMFT is the exact-exchange-based reduction, whereas TAO-DFT results when exact exchange is replaced by a density-based exchange-correlation functional. Numerical calculations confirm that i-DMFT, apart from a constant, coincides with the exact-exchange realization of the framework, and show that the improved dissociation behavior from finite-temperature occupations extends beyond exact exchange to hybrid and semilocal density functionals. For strongly correlated V2O3, finite-temperature occupations substantially reduce the severely overestimated non-magnetic LDA bulk modulus, bringing it close to experiment. These results establish FT-AC-RDMFT as a common theoretical foundation for finite-temperature occupation-based electronic-structure methods in molecular and solid-state systems.

papers.title: Crossed Electric Spin Generation in Multilayers
papers.abstract: We propose a crossed electric spin generation effect in multilayer structures. This effect combines the advantages of in-plane and gate electric fields for manipulating spin, and unveils a nice quantum geometric structure in terms of the underlying hybrid Berry curvatures that are unique to quasi-2D systems and manifest inherent spin-layer-orbital coupling. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict sizable spin generation in 2D ferromagnetic Fe3GeTe2 and altermagnetic V2Te2O. Our theory opens a new Berry-curvature route for all-electric spin manipulation in 2D materials

papers.title: Magnon Klein paradox
papers.abstract: By considering the energy transport of spin wave, we show that, like the electron Klein paradox, there is no magnon Klein paradox for reflectivity. Heuristically, this can be understood according to the fact that, even if the ground state is unstable, any energy-carrying wave cannot have greater-than-one reflectivity off a passive interface, which will violate the conservation of energy. The magnon Klein paradox discussed in the literature is derived from assigning a wrong sign to the transmitted spin wave.

papers.title: Chemical-Potential-Dependent Superconducting Spectroscopy on Bi2Te3/NbSe2 Heterostructures
papers.abstract: High-resolution scanning tunneling spectroscopy performed at dilution refrigerator temperatures was employed to investigate the superconducting properties of topological insulator/superconductor (Bi2Te3/NbSe2) heterostructures. Coherence peaks with inner kinks or inner peaks, deviating from the conventional single s-wave spectral line shape, were observed in both 5 quintuple-layer (5QL) and 7QL Bi2Te3 thin films. Based on the combination of chemical-potential-dependent spectroscopic measurements and model simulations, we conclude that these spectral features arise from contributions of bulk and surface states in Bi2Te3 by selectively proximity-coupled to a single superconducting gap from NbSe2, rather than inheriting the complicated superconductor's order parameter of NbSe2.

papers.title: Enhancing Quasi-Two-Dimensional Electronic Structure in Bi2O2Se via Chlorine Substitution
papers.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. First-principles calculations attribute this selective tunability to the unique spatial separation between conductive Bi-O layers and dopant Se/Cl layers, which enables independent optimization of interlayer coupling and intralayer transport. Remarkably, our theoretical calculations combined with experimental observations project a broad bandgap engineering across a wide range (0.8 ~ 3.5 eV) within the Bi2O2Se system. Our findings not only expand the application potential of Bi2O2Se-based materials in optoelectronics, nanoelectronics, and fundamental research but also highlight spatial decoupling as a viable strategy for modifying detailed electronic structure of quasi-2D quantum systems.

papers.title: A Fisher-Geometric Approach to Supercell Pair Distribution Function Refinement
papers.abstract: Refining atomistic supercells against powder pair distribution functions (PDFs) requires optimizing many coupled atomic coordinates using a much smaller set of radial measurements. Reverse-mode differentiation makes gradients accessible for large systems, but standard first-order optimizers do not explicitly use coupled PDF sensitivities to precondition coordinate updates. We introduce a matrix-free, Fisher-geometric approach that pulls the information metric of the observation likelihood back onto atomic coordinates. The resulting update weights collective displacements according to their PDF response and experimental uncertainty. Under isotropic damping, the update is obtained by solving a damped linear system over $M$ PDF channels, using automatic differentiation to evaluate Jacobian--vector and vector--Jacobian products without constructing the full Jacobian or coordinate curvature matrix. For Gaussian measurement errors, the update recovers classical Levenberg--Marquardt refinement while avoiding dense coordinate-space factorization. The same computational framework accommodates correlated Gaussian errors and robust likelihood-based updates. This approach combines likelihood-aware collective updates with matrix-free backpropagation for direct second-order refinement of large atomistic supercells.

papers.title: Surface Granular flows: Two Related Examples
papers.abstract: Granular surface flows are common in industrial practice and natural systems, however, theoretical description of such flows is at present incomplete. Two prototype systems involving surface flow are compared: heap formation by pouring at a point and rotating cylinders. Continuum models for analysis of these flows are reviewed, and experimental results for quasi-2d systems are presented. Experimental results in both systems are well described by continuum models.

papers.title: Optoelectronically Enabled Simultaneous and Decoupled Navigation and Selective Pairing of Electrically Driven Janus Particles for Multi-Agent Microrobotics
papers.abstract: Self-propelled Janus particles are promising active agents for microscale manipulation and microrobotic applications. However, when powered by a global external energy source, such as an electric, magnetic, or optical field, all particles respond simultaneously, preventing their independent and concurrent control. Achieving parallel, decoupled control without continuous particle-specific feedback, while preserving intrinsic self-propulsion, remains a significant challenge. Here, we present an optoelectronic (OE) strategy for simultaneously and independently controlling electrically driven, self-propelled metallo-dielectric Janus particles (JPs) using spatially programmable virtual electrodes. These electrodes are generated by projecting a single predefined illumination pattern from a digital micromirror device onto a photoconductive surface. The resulting confinement landscape enables multiple JPs to follow distinct trajectories without continuous monitoring, feedback, or pattern reconfiguration. We demonstrate controlled pairing of JPs with passive polystyrene particles and biological cells. For automated multi-agent operation, an image-based assignment framework identifies optimal agent-target pairs, excludes intersecting trajectories, and generates a single composite pattern for simultaneous, selective pair formation without real-time updating. Finally, we demonstrate independent manipulation of multiple magnetically rolling JPs under a globally applied magnetic field. Overall, this programmable open-loop strategy provides a versatile framework for multi-agent microrobotic manipulation, with potential applications in in-vitro micromanipulation and microfluidic systems.

papers.title: Exotic metallic phase in a heterotic Kondo lattice: violation of Luttinger's theorem and absence of Kondo gap
papers.abstract: Fermi surface transformation accompanied by quantum phase transition is widely observed in correlated electron systems including heavy fermion materials and van der Waals quantum heterostructures. The unified Anderson lattice description for this phenomenon suggests that their interacting ground states in the case of electron half filling always destabilize the metallic phase in the strong Kondo-coupling regime. We examine this issue within the paramagnetic phase of a Kondo lattice system with a heterotic layered structure. In the weak Kondo-coupling regime, the system exhibits a fractional Dirac liquid involving the massless or massive Dirac fermions and a charge neutral spinon Fermi surface. In the strong Kondo-coupling regime, the spinons hybridize with the Dirac fermions resulting in an intermediate nearly-flat hybridizing band together with the conduction and valence heavy fermion bands, yielding a large electric Fermi surface. Absence of the Kondo gap between these bands is observed depending on the stacking configurations of the layered structure. In particular, the system remains metallic even at the exact half filling in this regime and Luttinger's theorem is violated across the critical point. Implications of these results on the van der Waals quantum heterostructures are briefly discussed.

papers.title: Quantum Geometry and Pair Breaking in Intra- and Intervalley Superconductivity of Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: The observation of superconductivity emerging from a spin- and valley-polarized normal state in rhombohedral graphene raises a basic puzzle: intravalley Cooper pairs involve states that are not generically degenerate because of trigonal warping, and therefore lack the particle--particle nesting underlying the conventional Cooper instability. While recent model studies suggest that nontrivial band geometry can strongly promote chiral pairing, how this geometric enhancement competes with realistic band-structure-induced pair breaking remains unclear. Here we study Kohn--Luttinger superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral tetralayer graphene using a DFT-fitted multiorbital tight-binding model, retaining the full Bloch-wave-function form factors in both RPA screening and the projected Cooper interaction. We separate the superconducting instability into three contributions: the symmetry-resolved form-factor-dressed interaction, the Cooper-pair phase space determined by the symmetrized pair dispersion, and the energy mismatch generated by trigonal warping. We find that the Bloch form factors strongly favor intravalley pairing, with a leading predominantly $p_x-ip_y$ instability and a substantially larger maximum $T_c$ than the intervalley reference state. At the same time, trigonal-warping-induced mismatch cuts off the Cooper logarithm and confines intravalley superconductivity to a much narrower region of the phase diagram. The dominant instability occurs near pair-Lifshitz transitions and primarily in reconstructed annular or three-lobed Fermi-surface regimes. Our results show that superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene is controlled by the combined effects of quantum-geometry-dressed interactions, pair fermiology, and trigonal-warping-induced pair breaking.

papers.title: Soft-to-Rigid: Shape Continuation as an Alternative Search for Packing Congruent Shapes
papers.abstract: Searches for dense packings of congruent shapes move rigid pieces. Hardening starts each piece as its inscribed disk and deforms it into the target shape while the container is compressed. We ask whether it is a search worth running alongside existing ones, and test it at matched budget and comparable tuning against rigid starts, growth, simulated annealing and perturbation--compression on seven families of squares, triangles, hexagons and disks in squares, triangles and circles (188 instances), scoring each method by the lowest container size it reaches. Hardening is not a better default: tuned rigid starts reach the lowest size most often. It is a different search. On squares in a square it reaches packings the other four methods miss, including Trump's n = 11 and Wainwright's n = 19 in 32 runs per method, and in a targeted follow-up campaign at ten times the budget (16 runs per method) it is the only one to reach the best known packings for n = 17 and n = 26, while annealing alone reaches n = 27. In exploratory ablations, compressing disks and then switching to polygons at once, or growing rigid polygons along hardening's area schedule, shows no detectable difference from rigid starts, and hardening's unique packings contain more tilted pieces. The bias costs elsewhere: hardening is worse on triangles and on four families held out from all development, where the short-pilot policy we tested showed no detected advantage over always starting rigid. Shape continuation is an alternative search that reaches different packings, worth keeping beside rigid ones; we did not show that splitting a fixed budget between them pays, and we have no test that predicts where it helps. Search campaigns were planned before they ran, with amendments, exploratory analyses and post-hoc checks identified separately; every run is replayable and every number is generated from an event log.

papers.title: Fluctuation-based evaluation of thermal conductivity using deviational phonon Monte Carlo simulations
papers.abstract: We develop a fluctuation based Monte Carlo method for evaluating thermal conductivity within the phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) framework. Starting from the energy based variance reduced formulation of the BTE, we derive a relation between the spatial spreading of deviational phonon energy and the macroscopic heat conduction equation. The resulting formulation expresses thermal conductivity in terms of the mean square displacement of deviational phonon particles, without imposing thermal reservoirs. Consequently, thermal conductivity along multiple directions can be evaluated from a single simulation. The method is demonstrated for crystalline silicon at room temperature in bulk, square nanowires, and anisotropic polycrystalline nanostructures. The calculated thermal conductivities agree with theoretical predictions, including the size dependence induced by phonon boundary scattering and the mode-resolved contributions. For anisotropic polycrystalline structures, the method simultaneously resolves the directional thermal conductivities and captures their dependence on grain morphology. These results demonstrate the validity of the proposed fluctuation-based approach for evaluating thermal conductivity across different transport regimes and structural configurations.

papers.title: Large Out-of-plane Polarization in Two-dimensional Bi2O3 Monolayers Predicted by an AI-driven Inverse-design Workflow
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) polar oxides with built-in electric fields offer promising opportunities for nanoscale electronics, optoelectronics, and surface charge engineering. However, their discovery remains challenging due to the enormous structural complexity of nonlayered oxide networks. Here, we combine inverse structural design with a machine-learning interatomic potential and first-principles calculations to explore 2D oxide configurations. Using Bi2O3 as a representative system, we identify two previously unreported polar monolayers with tetragonal and orthorhombic symmetries. Both structures exhibit vertically separated Bi and O sublayers, giving rise to pronounced intrinsic polarity with Berry-phase 2D polarizations of 34.12 and 37.15 pC/m, respectively. Notably, the o-Bi2O3 monolayer exhibits one of the largest reported out-of-plane polarizations among 2D oxides. Both monolayers exhibit dynamical stability, finite-temperature structural integrity, and wide band gaps (~3.8 eV). The large polarization originates from dimensionality-induced reconstruction of the nonlayered Bi-O network, which breaks local coordination symmetry and produces out-of-plane charge redistribution, while the stereochemically active Bi 6s2 lone pair further favors asymmetric Bi-O bonding. These findings suggest dimensionality-induced local-coordination symmetry breaking as a promising design motif for high-polarization 2D oxides, and demonstrate the utility of combining inverse design with machine-learning-assisted screening to explore unconventional polar phases in nonlayered oxide networks.

papers.title: Transport kinetics in excitonic Mott insulator
papers.abstract: Indirect excitons (IXs) in a periodic moiré potential in a van der Waals heterostructure form an experimental platform for exploring Bose-Hubbard physics, including the superfluid state and the Mott insulator state. The realization of these collective states requires low-disorder materials. In particular, the localization due to the Mott insulator must be distinguished from disorder-induced localization. We studied the transport kinetics of IXs in a MoSe$_2$/WSe$_2$ van der Waals heterostructure with an anomalously high IX mobility, consistent with superfluidity. This high-mobility transport demonstrates that disorder-induced localization is negligible. We found a remarkable suppression of this efficient IX transport, directly indicating the Mott insulator. As the IX density increases during the excitation pulse, the IX cloud initially expands and then contracts upon entering the Mott insulator phase. The emergence of IX cloud contraction is accompanied by a peak in the IX spatial distribution at the origin. Our simulations reproduce the observed non-monotonic IX transport kinetics, including the temporal expansion and contraction of the IX cloud, as well as the peak in its spatial distribution.

papers.title: Pre-pairing and polarization of doped charge carriers in unconventional superconductors
papers.abstract: Based on first principles calculations, we show in hole-doped La2-xSrxCuO4, the Sr dopants prefer to form dimers, rather than be isolated as generally believed. Same trend applies to other superconductors such as Na-doped Ca2CuO2Cl2, and electron type Nd2-xCexCuO4. The dimer structure makes the two doped holes (electrons) bound up and form a singlet which is also polarized. Another type of dopant in cuprates is oxygen which behaves similarly. So, we propose that, for all oxide high TC superconductors, the holes (electrons) are pre-paired (Z-pairs) during the preparation of the superconductor. The spontaneously formed Z-pairs are conceptually different from not only the Cooper pairs, but also the Zhang-Rice singlets. The attraction force in a Z-pair originates basically from the strong antiferromagnetic exchange energy. We also found that the on-site Coulomb repulsion (U) is no longer a constant due to doping. Around a doping site, U can reduce its value discontinuously, which plays a key role in stabilizing the Z-pairs against isolated holes (electrons). A Z-pair is a p-wave like localized state which breaks the symmetry of the CuO2 plain and attracts each other along the direction perpendicular to the polarization. The Z-pairs may be popular in all of the unconventional superconductors and the periodic assembly can result in the emergence of coherence states and superconductivity.

papers.title: Biomolecular condensates and their pathologies: A colloidal, interfacial, and transport perspective
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates are micron-scale, membraneless compartments that concentrate proteins and nucleic acids by liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Condensates play critical roles in transcription, mRNA metabolism, stress responses, and signaling across the cell, with their dysregulation increasingly correlated with several pathologies spanning neurodegeneration, cancer, cardiometabolic disease, and viral infections. The emergent biology of condensates can be cohesively viewed through the framework of colloidal, interfacial, and transport phenomena. Here we review the condensate literature through this joint lens, treating each condensate as a biological colloid whose behavior is captured by four measurable physical quantities: a Flory--Huggins interaction parameter that determines whether the dense phase forms at all, a partition coefficient that dictates the degree of client molecule accumulation, a viscoelastic relaxation time that sets whether the dense phase responds as a liquid or a solid, and an interfacial tension that governs droplet shape and interfacial dynamics. Each quantity is traced to its physical origin, its measured range in biological condensates, and the techniques that quantify it, for both three-dimensional droplets and two-dimensional membrane-tethered condensates. Interpreting disease as the displacement of these physical quantities from their functional ranges, we reorganize condensate pathologies into a small set of physical failure modes --- saturation concentration dysregulation, aberrant aging and liquid-to-solid transitions, disrupted partitioning, interfacial aggregation, and pathogen hijacking --- and show how the same parameters become design variables for condensate-targeted drugs and engineered coacervate delivery vehicles. The review concludes with open questions at the interface of condensate biology and colloidal and interfacial science.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述；以胶体、界面与输运物理框架整合凝聚物文献；研究对象：生物分子凝聚物（biomolecular condensates），包括三维液滴与二维膜锚定凝聚物

papers.title: Atoms that Matter: Largest Materials Datasets Are 99% Redundant, and Local Chemistry Can Guide the Required 1%
papers.abstract: General-purpose machine-learning force fields (MLFFs) for materials are now trained on the order of $100$ million structures, assuming transferability requires such scale. We test this premise on OMat24, the largest available materials dataset, by training MACE models on subsets of $6.5$ million atoms, less than $1\%$ of OMat24, selected in three complementary ways: at random, by latent-space clustering of a pretrained MLFF (DIRECT), and by a new model-free method maximizing the diversity of discrete, interpretable local environments (EnvTok). All three models approach the full-data reference MACE-OMAT-0 model to within a few tens of $\mathrm{meV}/\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ in forces, and remain close to or exceed it on formation energies, elastic moduli, heat capacities, Li$^{+}$ migration barriers, and molecular-dynamics stability up to $3000\,$K and $500\,$GPa. This near-independence from the selection strategy shows that chemical environment diversity, not size, defines OMat24's information content: the remaining $99\%$ of structures are largely redundant. Broad sampling of chemical space thus remains essential, but reference labels are needed only for structurally and chemically distinct configurations. Using atomic positions and species, optionally augmented by magnetic moments, EnvTok identifies these before any labelling or training, yielding compact, architecture-independent datasets. This hundredfold reduction makes hybrid-DFT or higher-level relabelling of general-purpose training sets feasible, and frees computational budget for extending environmental coverage and multi-fidelity learning.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；基于OMat24训练MACE模型并做多任务基准比较；研究对象：OMat24材料数据集及在其子集上训练的MACE机器学习力场（MLFF）

证据与比较：在650万原子子集上训练三种选择策略的模型，力误差与MACE-OMAT-0相差数十meV/Å，并在形成能、弹性模量、热容、Li⁺迁移势垒及3000 K、500 GPa分子动力学稳定性上接近或超过参考模型。

papers.title: Direct Observation of Chirality-Dependent Berry Curvature Dipole via Cross-Axial Nonlinear Hall Effect in Trigonal Te
papers.abstract: Quantum geometric quantities, such as Berry curvature (BC) and quantum metric, are known to govern the physical and topological properties of materials, making access to these quantities critically important for the comprehensive understanding of the materials. Chiral crystals offer a natural platform in which structural handedness can control quantum geometry and nonlinear transport, but direct experimental access to the quantum geometric quantities has remained elusive. Here, we show that trigonal tellurium (Te) hosts an enantiomer-dependent Berry curvature dipole (BCD) that can be accessed through the measurement of cross-axial nonlinear Hall effect (NHE), unlike previously studied in-plane configurations where the BCD contribution vanishes. Angle-resolved measurements on left- and right-handed Te devices reveal a second-order transverse response whose sign reverses with crystal chirality. The extracted cross-axial nonlinear susceptibility, $χ_{yxz}$, exceeds the in-plane susceptibility, $χ_{xxx}$, by more than two-folds, indicating a strong BCD-driven contribution. First-principles calculations attribute this behavior to a topologically nontrivial hedgehog-like BC texture near the H points and predict a BCD that reverses sign between opposite enantiomers, consistent with experiment. These results establish cross-axial nonlinear Hall transport as a symmetry-selective probe of chirality-controlled quantum geometry in tellurium and related chiral materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与第一性原理计算结合的混合研究，依据为器件测量与计算结果对照；研究对象：三方晶系碲（trigonal Te）的左旋与右旋对映体器件
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三方碲的Berry曲率偶极（BCD）依赖对映体手性，可通过交叉轴向非线性霍尔效应（NHE）直接观测，其符号随晶体手性反转。

研究问题：如何在实验上直接获取手性晶体中由结构手性调控的量子几何量（如BCD），而非依赖面内构型中BCD贡献消失的测量方式。
证据与比较：对左旋与右旋Te器件做角分辨测量，观测到二阶横向响应且符号随手性反转；提取的交叉轴向非线性磁化率χ_yxz超过面内χ_xxx两倍以上；第一性原理计算给出H点附近hedgehog型BC织构及对映体间反号的BCD，与实验一致。
papers.method_zh: 左/右旋Te器件的角分辨交叉轴向非线性霍尔输运测量，辅以第一性原理计算BCD与Berry曲率织构。

english_guide.evidence: Angle-resolved measurements on left- and right-handed Te devices show a second-order transverse response reversing sign with chirality; extracted cross-axial susceptibility χ_yxz exceeds in-plane χ_xxx by more than two-fold; first-principles calculations give a hedgehog-like BC texture near H points and an enantiomer-reversing BCD consistent with experiment.

papers.title: Explicit Solvents Reverse Temperature Dependence of Phase Behavior in Charged Fluids
papers.abstract: In most theories of electrolyte and polyelectrolyte solutions, the solvent is treated implicitly as a dielectric continuum. While this approximation has enabled major advances, it neglects coupling between ionic and dipolar degrees of freedom. Using molecular dynamics simulations and the mean-spherical approximation, we show that this coupling qualitatively alters electrostatically driven phase behaviour. At finite ion concentrations, many-body ion-dipole correlations reverse the temperature dependence of effective electrostatic interactions, leading to upper-critical solution temperature (UCST) behaviour in direct contrast to the lower-critical solution temperature (LCST) behaviour predicted by implicit-solvent electrostatic theories. This phase reversal arises from ion-induced suppression of local dipolar screening, a collective effect inaccessible to pairwise implicit-solvent descriptions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论结合；依据为分子动力学模拟和平均球近似；研究对象：有限离子浓度下的带电流体（电解质/聚电解质溶液），显式溶剂偶极自由度
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 显式溶剂下离子-偶极多体关联会反转有效静电相互作用的温度依赖，使体系呈UCST行为，而非隐式溶剂理论预言的LCST行为。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：隐式溶剂把溶剂当作介电连续介质，忽略离子与偶极自由度耦合；该耦合是否定性改变静电驱动的相行为。
证据与比较：摘要报告：在有限离子浓度下，分子动力学模拟与平均球近似均显示多体离子-偶极关联使有效静电相互作用的温度依赖反向，相行为由LCST转为UCST；机制归因于离子诱导的局域偶极屏蔽抑制。摘要未给出具体数值、浓度范围或相图数据。
papers.method_zh: 采用分子动力学模拟与平均球近似（mean-spherical approximation）理论分析，显式处理溶剂偶极自由度。

english_guide.question: Does coupling between ionic and dipolar degrees of freedom, neglected by implicit-solvent dielectric-continuum treatments, qualitatively alter electrostatically driven phase behavior?
english_guide.evidence: Molecular dynamics simulations and the mean-spherical approximation show that at finite ion concentrations many-body ion-dipole correlations reverse the temperature dependence of effective electrostatic interactions; the phase reversal is attributed to ion-induced suppression of local dipolar screening. No quantitative values, concentration ranges, or phase diagrams are given in the abstract.

papers.title: Competitive scaling of small-subsystem-optimization heuristics for LABS
papers.abstract: The low autocorrelation binary sequences (LABS) problem, often formulated as a spin-lattice energy-minimization problem, is a combinatorial optimization problem with a very rugged energy landscape. We demonstrate that iterative optimization of very small subsystems of n spins that are decoupled from the rest of the system achieves global optimization of LABS with a time-to-solution scaling that is competitive with heuristics that optimize the global system of N spins directly. Our isolated-subsystem heuristic with n = 4 achieves a time scaling of O(1.333^N ) on the interval N = [27, 60], while the current state-of-the-art classical and quantum scalings are respectively O(1.34^N ) and O(1.21^N ). Our results suggest that specialized optimization hardware with only small numbers of logical spins may be of practical relevance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算研究；基于启发式算法的时间复杂度标度分析；研究对象：低自相关二进制序列（LABS）问题，表述为自旋晶格能量最小化
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对与其余系统解耦的极小n自旋子系统做迭代优化，可在N=27–60区间以O(1.333^N)时间标度实现LABS全局优化，与直接优化全局N自旋的启发式相当。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否仅迭代优化解耦的小子系统而非全局N自旋系统，仍达到LABS全局优化，并获得有竞争力的求解时间标度？
证据与比较：摘要给出孤立子系统启发式在n=4时于N=[27,60]区间的time-to-solution标度为O(1.333^N)，并与当前经典O(1.34^N)和量子O(1.21^N)标度作数值比较；未提供具体运行时间或硬件数据。
papers.method_zh: 迭代优化与其余系统解耦的n自旋小子系统（isolated-subsystem heuristic），n=4，并分析time-to-solution随N的标度。

english_guide.finding: Iterative optimization of very small subsystems of n spins decoupled from the rest achieves global optimization of LABS with time-to-solution scaling competitive with heuristics optimizing the global N-spin system directly.
english_guide.question: Can iterative optimization of small decoupled subsystems, rather than the global N-spin system, still achieve global optimization of LABS with competitive time-to-solution scaling?
english_guide.evidence: The isolated-subsystem heuristic with n=4 achieves a time scaling of O(1.333^N) on N=[27,60], compared with state-of-the-art classical O(1.34^N) and quantum O(1.21^N) scalings; no runtime or hardware data are given.
english_guide.method: Iterative optimization of small subsystems of n spins decoupled from the rest of the system (isolated-subsystem heuristic), with n=4, plus time-to-solution scaling analysis versus N.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that iterative optimization of very small decoupled subsystems achieves global LABS optimization with scaling competitive with global-system heuristics, suggesting practical relevance for specialized hardware with few logical spins.
english_guide.limitations: Scaling claims are limited to N=[27,60] and n=4; larger N, other n values, and actual hardware feasibility are not addressed in the abstract.
